method: Client reads the CALIBRATED value from a co-registered data raster (not the colorized PNG). Ship a parallel low-bit-depth BT/reflectance data tile (or a compact per-tile lookup) alongside each display tile; hover -> sample data tile at pixel -> show BT in K/C.
taw_share: SHARED inspector: same value-probe component TAW uses for RTMA/model; sat plugs a BT source into it.
pre_render_fit: Backend writes a data-value raster (e.g. 8-16 bit) per product-timestep next to the display raster in R2. Small.
free_economics: ~2x raster storage for products where inspection matters (IR/BT); still tiny (<$/mo).
validation: Hover value within +-1 K of source netCDF BT at 100 random pixels/product.

tool: Draw / annotate (fronts, troughs, drylines, text, pressure)
method: Client-side vector canvas/SVG layer over the imagery; symbol palette (WPC front glyphs); serialized to JSON. Baked into PNG/GIF exports server-side or client-side compositing.
taw_share: SHARED draw tool = the same MapLibre draw/annotate layer TAW builds; sat viewer mounts the identical component.
pre_render_fit: No backend render needed for drawing; export step composites vectors onto frames.
free_economics: ~$0 (client-side); annotations stored in localStorage / optional edge-KV.
validation: Front glyphs render correctly at all zooms; export includes annotations pixel-accurate.

method: Client geodesic (haversine/Vincenty) on map coords; polyline + readout. Domain-aware because MapLibre carries the projection.
taw_share: SHARED measure tool with TAW (identical component).
validation: Great-circle distance within 0.1% of reference for 10 known city pairs.

method: Pin lat/lon -> for each frame in the loaded loop, sample the BT/value data tile at that point -> plot value vs time. Reuses the inspector's data-tile sampling across the loop.
taw_share: SHARED: same pin+extract engine TAW uses for model meteograms.
pre_render_fit: Needs the per-timestep data rasters (same as inspector) already in R2.
validation: Series matches manual netCDF extraction at pinned point across a 60-frame loop.

method: N synchronized viewport instances sharing one clock + AOI; each pane independent product/overlay. Canvas/ImageBitmap reused; one timeline drives all.
taw_share: SHARED layout shell with TAW multi-pane compare.
pre_render_fit: Just multiple hydrations from the same R2 tiles; no new backend.
free_economics: More read ops per session (N panes) but CDN-cached; negligible.
validation: Frames across panes stay within 0 timestep of each other during playback.

tool: PNG / GIF / MP4 export (90-frame GIF, <=10MB Discord)
method: Client assembles ImageBitmap frames -> encode. GIF via gif.js/wasm; MP4 via WebCodecs where available. Size lever: resolution x frame-count x palette. 'Discord-safe' mode caps at 10MB by dropping resolution first, keeping 90 frames + true palette. TAT palette baked so colors don't shift.
taw_share: Shared export/encoder module (map snapshot to GIF/MP4) usable by TAW.
pre_render_fit: Uses already-loaded frames; optional server-side high-res encode worker for full-sharp.
free_economics: Client encode = $0 compute. Server encode worker only if user wants full-res; cheap + on-demand.
validation: 90-frame GIF renders <=10MB in Discord-safe mode with no palette drift vs source.

method: REWORK per Andrew: draw box = VIEWPORT CHANGE over the pre-rendered tile pyramid (pan/zoom + clip), NEVER an on-demand server render (the weathernerds anti-pattern). Preset-region list + freehand box both resolve to a viewport rect on the pyramid.
pre_render_fit: Core fit: this is exactly the SLIDER model - one pyramid, infinite viewports.
free_economics: $0 extra (viewports are free reads over existing tiles).
validation: Any AOI renders from cached tiles in <300ms with no origin render call.

method: KEEP+EXPAND: jump to any date/time; hot recent window pre-rendered, older = render-on-demand from free NOAA/AWS/JMA raw + short-TTL cache; event bookmarks for notable storms; spans satellite GENERATIONS (registry handles changing res/channels/format).
pre_render_fit: Tiered: hot pre-render -> R2; cold on-demand render worker -> cache. (See economics.)
free_economics: Hot window ~$15/mo; deep archive on-demand ~flat compute; pre-storing whole era = 100-1000x more.
validation: Jump to any timestamp 2017-now returns imagery; a 2005 GVAR/GridSat date returns hourly IR.
